title: Highberg is the least-resolved Dutch firm in the lead set
content:
Highberg is the least-resolved of the Dutch firms in the lead set. Nothing about its stack, size or open-source posture was researched, so it ranks last on evidence rather than last on merit — the distinction being that no negative finding has been recorded against it.

The note exists to mark the gap. In a Dutch cohort where most names carry either a Common Ground connection, a stated open-source posture or a named client, an entry with none of the three is either a genuinely poor fit or simply unexamined, and the record as it stands cannot tell which. Priority 4, needs OSS screen.
